title: Oliver Reiser's tone theory and letters with Puharich

tellings.quote: But anyways, Puharich knew this guy. They exchanged like dozens and dozens of letters. But this guy's theory,

plain: A researcher on a podcast says that Oliver Reiser, a thinker at the University of Pittsburgh, wrote dozens and dozens of letters to Andrija Puharich, a man known for research into psychic matters, in the 1960s and 1970s. Reiser, he says, had a theory about tones, set out in his book Cosmic Humanism, and the researcher connects it to Albert Einstein. It is told as part of the background to Puharich's ideas about contact with other minds.
